messages:
alex: Anyone seen weird token read errors on WSL2 after laptop lid sleep? My CLI suddenly says 'keyring: no backend available' when calling redwood auth.
mari: yep. Windows keyring gets funky after suspend. WSL distro can't talk to wincred unless wslg agent running.
sam: What OS? Windows 11? And which keyring backend is CLI using? libsecret vs wincred?
alex: Win11, WSL2 ubuntu. Redwood CLI uses OS keyring with fallback to file at ~/.redwood/tokens.json if keyring fails. But my fallback isn't working — it sometimes writes tokens to /mnt/c/Users/... and WSL sees stale file.
jin: We've seen this. Two approaches: 1) add a small sync script that runs on resume and copies tokens, 2) enable env REDWOOD_CLI_TOKEN_FILE to point to shared path. Also make sure keyring backend is explicit.
devex-bot: Tip: set REDWOOD_CLI_AUTH_BACKEND=env or file to force fallback.
mari: I use this in powershell profile: set ENV var to point at /mnt/c and a small watcher on the WSL side.
alex: Can you paste watcher?
sam: ```bash
# /usr/local/bin/redwood-token-sync
#!/bin/bash
HOST_PATH="/mnt/c/Users/alex/.redwood/tokens.json"
WSL_PATH="$HOME/.redwood/tokens.json"
if [ -f "$HOST_PATH" ]; then
  cp -u "$HOST_PATH" "$WSL_PATH"
fi
# also copy back if newer
if [ "$WSL_PATH" -nt "$HOST_PATH" ]; then
  cp "$WSL_PATH" "$HOST_PATH"
fi
```
mari: I run it on systemd user resume + cron every 5m. For PowerShell (Windows side) use a Scheduled Task on workstation unlock.
jin: If you care about security, use KMS/HSM or at least file perms and a short TTL token refresh. CLI has `redwood auth refresh --if-expired`.
alex: Thanks. One more: how to make CI runners pick correct profile when using shared tokens? I want a script that selects profile per job and writes to REDWOOD_PROFILE env var.
sam: simple wrapper:
```bash
export REDWOOD_PROFILE="$1" # arg is profile name
redwood auth activate --profile "$REDWOOD_PROFILE"
# do stuff
```
mari: In GitHub Actions, use actions/cache to cache ~/.redwood, but be careful with secrets. Prefer per-job ephemeral creds from OIDC.
alex: Switching to OIDC later. For now watcher + env is good. I'll add flag to CLI config to prefer file path for WSL.
devex-bot: :thumbsup: created ticket DOCS-342 to add WSL auth troubleshooting and sample scripts.
sam: Also consider adding `--no-keyring` flag to force file-only for headless scripts — useful for CI.
alex: sweet, thanks all. I'll PR the script and docs.
